rv.q: As an actor himself, he knows how to write whacking good parts and has all the benefits of a meticulous National production, but he rarely makes you feel the family he portrays can provide a metaphor for a generation. The setting, vividly created by Vicki Mortimer, is a dilapidated art deco house on Devon's south coast.
The Last of the Haussmans is exposed on the vast Lyttelton stage as a promising debut rather than a seriously accomplished one.
